title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta24

## Zone progress and settings reliability

This beta corrects three issues affecting current map totals and settings updates.

- **Current map totals:** Zones removed from a confirmed updated map no longer inflate its displayed area, zone count or mowing coverage. Historical zone records are retained, and temporary missing or incomplete map data will not remove valid zones.
- **Device-command tracking:** Settings status checks now continue past pending responses until a final response or bounded timeout, giving more useful diagnostics when a command is delayed or rejected.
- **Partial settings writes:** When the device command succeeds but a later settings persistence step fails, NaviMower now records the partial outcome instead of showing the requested value as fully applied. Readback remains available and the original command is not resent automatically.

These changes do not add new mower controls or change account authentication, schedules, map geometry or mower history. No Map Card update is required.

### Validation

Regression tests cover retired-zone totals and history preservation, missing map snapshots, pending-to-answered command statuses and a partially completed settings write. Device-specific behavior will continue to be monitored in the beta line.
